_readme: Verified originals on file. Each entry maps a 128-bit capture id (decoded from the invisible mark) to the original, cryptographically verified capture. In the full design this is a cloud service the app uploads to at capture time; this static file holds a handful of demo captures so the compare-with-original flow can be tried today. Keys are the capture id as 32 lowercase hex chars (UUID without dashes); 'original' points to the exact sealed file under /samples/.
